about_the_game:
If you played Escape from Mandrillia and, for some reason, thought "dang, I sure hope I could pay MORE than I already paid for this thing", then you're in luck! By buying the Supporter Upgrade, you'll be directly supporting ME, the developer of Escape from Mandrillia. Why would anybody do that? I don't know!

This pack includes a full set of cosmetics for the Robot, as well as a bonus Coop Drone paintjob. As you might have guessed, they're all gold-themed as if to flaunt your riches to the Mandrillians.

Face gear: GOLD MASK

Cover your face with this stoic visage. Your enemies will never see again a tinge of fear in your eyes -just the unflinching gaze of someone that just spent 5 bucks on a digital trinket.

Head gear: GOLDEN HELMET

A carefully crafted piece in the image of a severed Mandrillian head, to assert your authority over their ranks.

Chest gear: GOLDEN CHESTPLATE

A ceremonial chestplate, styled after a Mandrillian's face. If the Mandrillians strike you, they would be striking a reflection of themselves. How could they sleep at night after that?

Hull: GOLDEN BOY

A shiny gold-plated body to match the rest of the set, covered with engravings. On its face, a single, all-seeing eye.

Bonus: COOP DRONE GOLDEN PAINTJOB

This one is not actually gold, they just gave the drones a coat of golden paintspray. It looks kinda cool!

MIX AND MATCH

Like all the cosmetics included in the base game, the Supporter Upgrade cosmetics can be freely combined. Find your style!
